title: Canonical graph-bound node authority content
description: OBJECTIVE: close the missing immutable NodeDefinition / recursive nodeAuthorityHash contract required by design sections 6.1, 10 and 14.2. CURRENT GAP: @moe/scheduler GraphRevisionContent carries only structural `{nodeKey, executionBearing}` nodes; NodeMission content comes from mutable spec files, DependencyContract is pure/unpersisted, and task-eacea969d636420b8f5c47304039e056 is blocked on a resolved canonical GraphRevisionContent producer. DELIVERABLE: a versioned, closed, canonical @moe/scheduler node-authority body that contains every design-required NodeDefinition field plus exact current direct-hard DependencyContract and witness bindings, derives recursive nodeAuthorityHash over criteria/plan/verification/workspace/resource/budget/base/policy/dependency authority, and is included in GraphRevisionContent canonical identity; publish the type/runtime closure through the scheduler root. NOT IN SCOPE: daemon persistence, graph transport, input-manifest materialization, budget accounting, or execution. Production derives canonical bytes and recursive nodeAuthorityHash over every authoritative field and integrates the full node-authority set into GraphRevisionContent hashing; structural node keys alone can no longer authenticate content.

Malformed, unsupported-version, duplicate, unordered, over-limit, noncanonical, digest/hash, graph/revision and dependency/witness binding failures return exact stable code and layer; no caller-supplied hash gains authority.
The @moe/scheduler root publishes the complete type/runtime closure, with temporary compiled and plain-Node bare-root probes deleted in the same command and the closed root namespace ratchet updated.

Tests include a nonempty multi-node/dependency control, positive-count hostile and authoritative-field mutation rosters, exact code/layer assertions, and mutation drills that redden graph-hash and recursive-dependency bindings; scheduler tests execute with nonzero Test Files/Tests counts and every production source remains <=250 lines.

comments.author: architect-44ece6ad
comments.content: Planning discovery found a normative hash cycle that must be resolved before implementation: current PlanRevision.planHash hashes graphBinding.graphContentHash, and AcceptanceContract.criteriaDigest hashes applicability.graphContentHash, while design §5.3/line 255 requires nodeAuthorityHash to include changed plan/criteria content and graphHash to include nodeAuthorityHash. Therefore target graphHash -> nodeAuthorityHash -> plan/criteria digest -> target graphHash. Revision IDs cannot break it because line 255 excludes revision IDs. Recommended resolution: first add graph-independent plan-content and criteria-content digests (canonical bodies excluding only target graph binding/self digest), use those in nodeAuthorityHash, bind DependencyContract.graphBindingDigest to the server-derived structural snapshot identity, and keep the full plan/criteria digests for outer target-graph approval. The requested implementation is also >10 files and needs SPIDR slices after this decision.
